building.label: building
building.description: a building people live or work in; its rooms furnished for what it is used for
building.outside: a building whose outside shows what it is used for

house.label: house
house.description: a family home of a pre-industrial village or town: a hearth and kitchen, a table and benches, bedrooms with beds and chests, shelves of crockery, lit by candles and the fire
house.outside: a family home: a front door and a few windows with shutters, a chimney, a homely size

townhouse.label: townhouse
townhouse.description: a narrow town house of a merchant or craftsman family: a parlour, a kitchen with a hearth, bedrooms upstairs, wooden panelling, candles and oil lamps
townhouse.outside: a narrow tall town house: a front door on the street, rows of windows on each storey, a chimney

shack.label: shack
shack.description: a poor one-room shack: a cot, a small stove or fire pit, a rough table, sacks and tools, a single lantern
shack.outside: a small poor shack: rough planks or patched walls, a crooked roof, a tiny door, a single small window or none

farmhouse.label: farmhouse
farmhouse.description: a farming family's house: a big kitchen hearth, a long table, a pantry of sacks and jars, farm tools by the door, simple bedrooms, candles and the fire
farmhouse.outside: a farm's house: a broad homely front, a big chimney, a porch by the door

manor.label: manor
manor.description: a noble family's manor house: a great hall with a long table and fireplace, tapestries and portraits, fine bedrooms with canopy beds, rugs, candelabra
manor.outside: a noble's manor: large and stately, a grand front door with steps, many tall windows, several chimneys, ornament

outbuilding.label: outbuilding
outbuilding.description: a small farm outbuilding: stored tools, sacks, barrels and firewood, a workbench
outbuilding.outside: a small plain farm outbuilding: one door, one or no window, simple walls and roof

barn.label: barn
barn.description: a farm barn: hay bales and a hayloft, stalls, carts, farm tools, sacks of grain, lanterns on hooks
barn.outside: a farm barn: huge double doors big enough for a cart, a hayloft door high up in the gable, few or no windows, plain boarded walls

shed.label: shed
shed.description: a garden or tool shed: tools on the walls, a workbench, pots, sacks, a lantern
shed.outside: a small shed: one plain door, no or one small window, a simple sloped or gabled roof

workshop.label: workshop
workshop.description: a craftsman's workshop: workbenches, tools on racks, materials and half-finished work, shelves of supplies, lamps
workshop.outside: a craftsman's workshop: wide doors or an open front to work in, a workbench or tools visible, a sign of its trade

inn.label: inn
inn.description: an inn: a common room with tables, benches and a bar with barrels, a hearth, guest rooms with beds upstairs, candles and lanterns
inn.outside: an inn: a hanging sign with its emblem, a welcoming front door, many windows lit warmly, a big chimney, often a porch or bench

stable.label: stable
stable.description: a stable: horse stalls with straw, saddles and tack on the walls, feed sacks and buckets, a hayloft, lanterns
stable.outside: a stable: a row of half-doors for the horses (split stable doors), a hayloft opening, low and long

shop.label: shop
shop.description: a shop: a counter, shelves and displays of goods, crates and barrels of stock, a back room, lamps
shop.outside: a shop: a shop front with a wide display window or open counter, an awning, a hanging sign of its trade

warehouse.label: warehouse
warehouse.description: a goods warehouse: rows of crates, barrels and sacks, shelving, a small office desk with ledgers, lanterns
warehouse.outside: a goods warehouse: wide cart doors on the ground floor, a loading door high up with a hoist beam and pulley above it, few small windows, plain sturdy walls

temple.label: temple
temple.description: a temple: an altar, statues of its gods, offering bowls and incense, braziers and candles, benches or prayer mats, banners
temple.outside: a temple: columns or a grand portal, wide steps to the entrance, a tall or domed roof, carvings and religious symbols

mill.label: mill
mill.description: a mill: millstones and wooden gears, sacks of grain and flour, a hopper, the miller's table, lanterns
mill.outside: a mill: big sails or a water wheel turning, a tall body, a loading door with a hoist

guard-tower.label: guard tower
